entities.name: RuvC resolvase
observations: The 179-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Dechloromonas aromatica RuvC (UniProt Q478E2); the reference annotates it as a Holliday-junction endonuclease (EC 3.1.21.10).
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 18,499 Da; pI 9.23; GRAVY 0.239; Pfam RuvC domain PF02075 spans residues 8–155.
Reference annotation reports Mg2+ cofactor, cytoplasmic localization, and roles in DNA recombination and repair.

entities.name: Mg2+
observations: Reviewed RuvC reference annotation reports Mg2+ as a cofactor and two Mg2+ ions bound per subunit.
